guarantees.claim: entropy_configured is combinationaly driven to prim_mubi_pkg::MuBi4True when st != StRandReset, else to prim_mubi_pkg::MuBi4False.
Synchronous prim_mubi4_sender instance u_entropy_configured transmits the mubi-encoded value from entropy_configured to entropy_configured_o, respecting clk_i and rst_ni.

assumptions.claim: Parameter RndCnstLfsrPerm must be a complete permutation of indices 0..EntropyOutputW-1 (all bit positions marked).
assumptions.risk: Missing or duplicate indices can lose or duplicate entropy bits, potentially making the output predictable and weakening secret keys/randomness.

uncertain_points.claim: If st transitions near a clock edge or glitches, the combinational entropy_configured may violate setup/hold at the synchronous prim_mubi4_sender, leading to metastability or a transient mubi symbol.
uncertain_points.cond: st changes while clk_i samples entropy_configured
uncertain_points.risk: A metastable or invalid mubi value on entropy_configured_o could be misinterpreted by downstream logic as a valid state change, undermining mubi protocol integrity.

uncertain_points.claim: An X or unknown value on st (e.g., from soft error) makes the comparison (st != StRandReset) potentially produce X, which then propagates to entropy_configured as X.
uncertain_points.risk: An X on the mubi bus may defeat downstream Mubi assertion checks (if they treat X as valid) or cause a deadlock; it could silently indicate a configured state when the module is not actually ready.

uncertain_points.claim: If st assumes any illegal encoding not equal to StRandReset, the condition (st != StRandReset) is true and entropy_configured will falsely indicate an entropy-configured state.
uncertain_points.cond: st is an illegal FSM state (e.g., due to cosmic upset)
uncertain_points.risk: Premature assertion of configured status could allow entropy processing before proper reset, potentially leaking uninitialized keying material or using wrong entropy state.
